newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ABB says in talks over 5.7 bln skr orders.
newsitem.headline: ABB says in talks over 5.7 bln skr orders.

text.p: Swedish-Swiss electrical engineering company Asea Brown Boveri AB ABB said on Friday it was in negotiations over two major contracts but said no deals had been finalised.

Swedish business daily Dagens Industri said on Friday ABB had two deals in the pipeline -- an electric cable link between Sweden and Poland for two billion crowns and a desalination and power plant project in Bahrain worth 3.7 billion crowns.
The newspaper said ABB was bidding as a member of a consortium for the Bahrain project but that ABB would take the major part of the order.
"ABB is in negotiations with Bahrain about this, but we have no contracts finalised," ABB spokesman Eric Osterberg told Reuters.
ABB had signed a letter of intent with Swedish state-controlled power plant Vattenfall about the cable link, but the deal hinged on approval from regulatory authorities, Osterberg said.
"Vattenfall is waiting for permission from Swedish and Polish authorities. We have a deal with Vattenfall so if the deal goes ahead, ABB will be there," Osterberg said.
